snippet.title: Trailer Mt.Apricot
snippet.description:
The first trailer for MT. Apricot is here! we would love for you to play our game! 
it's free to play on Itch.io
lets us know what your thoughts were, we love receiving feedback to improve the game!

have a lovely day!
The Mt.Apricot Team. 

Download - https://igad.itch.io/mt-apricot

"Mt. Apricot is facing its greatest challenge yet!

As mysterious goo is taking hold of the entire floating archipelago, it's up to our hero, Blueberry, to cleanse his home from the hazardous corruption"

First-year student project. 
International Game Architecture and Design at Breda University of Applied Sciences.
